SELECT id,id project_id,company_id,'project' kind,'projects.wbs' capability,NULL::text source_user_id FROM staff_projects
 UNION ALL SELECT id,project_id,company_id,'milestone','projects.wbs',NULL::text FROM staff_project_milestones
 UNION ALL SELECT id,project_id,company_id,'work_log','projects.time',user_id FROM staff_project_work_logs
 UNION ALL SELECT id,project_id,company_id,'allocation','projects.costs',NULL::text FROM staff_project_cost_allocations
 UNION ALL SELECT id,project_id,company_id,'handoff','projects.handover',NULL::text FROM staff_project_handoffs
 UNION ALL SELECT id,project_id,company_id,'task','projects.tasks',NULL::text FROM staff_tasks WHERE project_id IS NOT NULL
peopleSourceImage: SELECT jsonb_build_object('projects',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(evaluation_project)||jsonb_build_object('visible',{scope}) ORDER BY evaluation_project.id) FROM staff_projects evaluation_project WHERE evaluation_project.company_id=?),'members',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m) ORDER BY m.project_id,m.user_id) FROM staff_project_members m JOIN staff_projects p ON p.id=m.project_id WHERE p.company_id=?))::text image
peopleSourceRows: SELECT evaluation_project.id,evaluation_project.title,evaluation_project.version,evaluation_project.updated_at FROM staff_projects evaluation_project JOIN staff_project_members m ON m.project_id=evaluation_project.id WHERE evaluation_project.company_id=? AND m.user_id=? AND (?::text IS NULL OR evaluation_project.id=?) AND (?::text IS NULL OR evaluation_project.branch_id=?) AND (?::text IS NULL OR evaluation_project.department_id=?) AND {scope} ORDER BY evaluation_project.updated_at DESC LIMIT 100
